entry.title: Architecture design of diffusion model
entry.content:
学习下目前扩散模型中的架构设计

diffusion中常用设计与结构

DiT, Diffusion Transformer

ROPE, 旋转位置编码

LLM学习记录（五）–超简单的RoPE理解方式 - 知乎

对于每 2 个相邻的维度 $(x_{2i},x_{2i+1})$，定义旋转矩阵：

\[\mathbf{R}_m^{(i)} = \begin{pmatrix} \cos(m\theta_i) & -\sin(m\theta_i) \\ \sin(m\theta_i) & \cos(m\theta_i) \end{pmatrix}\]

其中旋转角度 $θ_{i}$ 按频率衰减(由于正余弦函数的周期性，保证尾部与头部的距离不比中间任意两个位置的距离短，theta一般取无法达到的数字，一般采用10000)：

\[\theta_i = \text{theta}^{-\frac{2i}{d}}, \quad i \in \{0, 1, \dots, d/2-1\}\]

应用旋转矩阵后，每个维度对的变换为：

\[\begin{pmatrix} x_{2i}' \\ x_{2i+1}' \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} \cos(m\theta_i) & -\sin(m\theta_i) \\ \sin(m\theta_i) & \cos(m\theta_i) \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} x_{2i} \\ x_{2i+1} \end{pmatrix}\]

展开得到高效计算公式：

\[\boxed{ \begin{aligned} x_{2i}' &= x_{2i} \cdot \cos(m\theta_i) - x_{2i+1} \cdot \sin(m\theta_i) \\ x_{2i+1}' &= x_{2i} \cdot \sin(m\theta_i) + x_{2i+1} \cdot \cos(m\theta_i) \end{aligned} }\]

Attention 分数计算时，RoPE 展现出美妙的数学性质(注意力分数只依赖于相对位置 n−mn−m)：

\[\begin{aligned} \langle \mathbf{q}_m', \mathbf{k}_n' \rangle &= \langle \mathbf{R}_m \mathbf{q}_m, \mathbf{R}_n \mathbf{k}_n \rangle \\ &= \langle \mathbf{q}_m, \mathbf{R}_m^\top \mathbf{R}_n \mathbf{k}_n \rangle \\ &= \langle \mathbf{q}_m, \mathbf{R}_{n-m} \mathbf{k}_n \rangle \end{aligned}\]

RoPE 可以用复数乘法优雅地表示：

\[z' = z \cdot e^{i m\theta} = (x_{\text{real}} + i x_{\text{imag}}) \cdot (\cos(m\theta) + i\sin(m\theta))\]

diffusers中的实现方式，截取flux对应的方式（diffusers/models/embeddings.py）：

def get_1d_rotary_pos_embed(
    dim: int,
    pos: Union[np.ndarray, int],
    theta: float = 10000.0,
    use_real=False,
    linear_factor=1.0,
    ntk_factor=1.0,
    repeat_interleave_real=True,
    freqs_dtype=torch.float32,  #  torch.float32, torch.float64 (flux)
):
    assert dim % 2 == 0

    if isinstance(pos, int):
        pos = torch.arange(pos)
    if isinstance(pos, np.ndarray):
        pos = torch.from_numpy(pos)  # type: ignore  # [S]

    theta = theta * ntk_factor
    freqs = (
        1.0 / (theta ** (torch.arange(0, dim, 2, dtype=freqs_dtype, device=pos.device) / dim)) / linear_factor
    )  # [D/2]
    freqs = torch.outer(pos, freqs)  # type: ignore   # [S, D/2]

    freqs_cos = freqs.cos().repeat_interleave(2, dim=1, output_size=freqs.shape[1] * 2).float()  # [S, D]
    freqs_sin = freqs.sin().repeat_interleave(2, dim=1, output_size=freqs.shape[1] * 2).float()  # [S, D]
    return freqs_cos, freqs_sin
   
def apply_rotary_emb(
    x: torch.Tensor,
    freqs_cis: Union[torch.Tensor, Tuple[torch.Tensor]],
    use_real: bool = True,
    use_real_unbind_dim: int = -1,
    sequence_dim: int = 2,
) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    cos, sin = freqs_cis  # [S, D]
    if sequence_dim == 2:
        cos = cos[None, None, :, :]
        sin = sin[None, None, :, :]
    elif sequence_dim == 1:
        cos = cos[None, :, None, :]
        sin = sin[None, :, None, :]

    cos, sin = cos.to(x.device), sin.to(x.device)

    if use_real_unbind_dim == -1:
        # Used for flux, cogvideox, hunyuan-dit
        x_real, x_imag = x.reshape(*x.shape[:-1], -1, 2).unbind(-1)  # [B, H, S, D//2]
        x_rotated = torch.stack([-x_imag, x_real], dim=-1).flatten(3)
    elif use_real_unbind_dim == -2:
        # Used for Stable Audio, OmniGen, CogView4 and Cosmos
        x_real, x_imag = x.reshape(*x.shape[:-1], 2, -1).unbind(-2)  # [B, H, S, D//2]
        x_rotated = torch.cat([-x_imag, x_real], dim=-1)
    out = (x.float() * cos + x_rotated.float() * sin).to(x.dtype)
    return out

代码中的旋转操作等价于矩阵乘法：

\[\begin{aligned} \text{x\_rotated} &= [-x_{\text{imag}}, x_{\text{real}}] \quad \text{(旋转90°)} \\ \text{out} &= x \cdot \cos\theta + \text{x\_rotated} \cdot \sin\theta \\ &= \begin{pmatrix} x_{\text{real}} \\ x_{\text{imag}} \end{pmatrix} \cos\theta + \begin{pmatrix} -x_{\text{imag}} \\ x_{\text{real}} \end{pmatrix} \sin\theta \\ &= \begin{pmatrix} x_{\text{real}}\cos\theta - x_{\text{imag}}\sin\theta \\ x_{\text{imag}}\cos\theta + x_{\text{real}}\sin\theta \end{pmatrix} \end{aligned}\] \[\phi_{m,i} = m \cdot \theta_i, \quad \text{freqs} = \text{outer}(\text{pos}, \theta) \in \mathbb{R}^{S \times d/2}\]

entry.title: Baisc diffusion theroy
entry.content:
推导一下扩散模型，主要还是基于Lil’ log What are Diffusion Models?这篇博客进行学习并自行推导。

Basic theory

forward（加噪）

对于一个真实数据域 $x_{0} \sim q(x)$ ，加噪 $T$ 步得到 noise sample sequences $ x_{1}, \dots, x_{T} $ ，通过 $ eta $ 控制步数，其中 $ { eta_{t} \in (0, 1)}_{t=1}^T$ ：

\[q(\mathbf{x}_{t} \vert \mathbf{x}_{t-1}) = \mathcal{N}(\mathbf{x}_{t}; \sqrt{1 - eta_{t}} \mathbf{x}_{t-1}, eta_{t}\mathbf{I}) \quad q(\mathbf{x}_{1:T} \vert \mathbf{x}_{0}) = \prod^T_{t=1} q(\mathbf{x}_{t} \vert \mathbf{x}_{t-1})\] \[ egin{aligned} \mathbf{x}_{t} &= \sqrt{\alpha_{t}}\mathbf{x}_{t-1} + \sqrt{1 - \alpha_{t}} oldsymbol{\epsilon}_{t-1} & ext{ ;where } oldsymbol{\epsilon}_{t-1}, oldsymbol{\epsilon}_{t-2}, \dots \sim \mathcal{N}(\mathbf{0}, \mathbf{I}) \ &= \sqrt{\alpha_{t} \alpha_{t-1}} \mathbf{x}_{t-2} + \sqrt{1 - \alpha_{t} \alpha_{t-1}} ar{ oldsymbol{\epsilon}}_{t-2} & ext{ ;where } ar{ oldsymbol{\epsilon}}_{t-2} ext{ merges two Gaussians (*).} \ &= \dots \ &= \sqrt{ ar{\alpha}_{t}}\mathbf{x}_{0} + \sqrt{1 - ar{\alpha}_{t}} oldsymbol{\epsilon} \ q(\mathbf{x}_{t} \vert \mathbf{x}_{0}) &= \mathcal{N}(\mathbf{x}_{t}; \sqrt{ ar{\alpha}_{t}} \mathbf{x}_{0}, (1 - ar{\alpha}_{t})\mathbf{I}) \end{aligned}\]

这里构建起直接的 $x_{0},x_{t}$ 之间的联系。

backward（降噪）

去噪就是在求 $q(x_{t-1} \vert x_{t})$ ，然而 $ q(x_{t-1} \mid x_{t}) = rac{q(x_{t} \mid x_{t-1}) \cdot q(x_{t-1})}{q(x_{t})}$ ，其中$q(x_{t} )$ 是需要依赖 $q(x_{0})$ 的，基于 $ x_{0},x_{t} $ 之间的直接联系，并借助贝叶斯公式可以求得：

\[q(\mathbf{x}_{t-1} \vert \mathbf{x}_{t}, \mathbf{x}_{0}) = \mathcal{N}(\mathbf{x}_{t-1}; { ilde{ oldsymbol{\mu}}}(\mathbf{x}_{t}, \mathbf{x}_{0}), { ilde{ eta}_{t}} \mathbf{I})\] \[ egin{aligned} q(\mathbf{x}_{t-1} \vert \mathbf{x}_{t}, \mathbf{x}_{0}) &= q(\mathbf{x}_{t} \vert \mathbf{x}_{t-1}, \mathbf{x}_{0}) rac{ q(\mathbf{x}_{t-1} \vert \mathbf{x}_{0}) }{ q(\mathbf{x}_{t} \vert \mathbf{x}_{0}) } \ \end{aligned}\] \[... (略过推导) \ egin{aligned} ilde{ eta}_{t} & = { rac{1 - ar{\alpha}_{t-1}}{1 - ar{\alpha}_{t}} \cdot eta_{t}} \ ilde{ oldsymbol{\mu}}_{t} &= { rac{1}{\sqrt{\alpha_{t}}} \Big( \mathbf{x}_{t} - rac{1 - \alpha_{t}}{\sqrt{1 - ar{\alpha}_{t}}} oldsymbol{\epsilon}_{t} \Big)} \end{aligned}\]

training objective

生成器为 $p_{ heta}()$, 可以通过类似VAE的变分下界去最大似然优化（optimize the negative log-likelihood）:

\[ egin{aligned} - \log p_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{0}) &\leq - \log p_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{0}) + D_ ext{KL}(q(\mathbf{x}_{1:T}\vert\mathbf{x}_{0}) \| p_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{1:T}\vert\mathbf{x}_{0}) ) & \small{ ext{; KL is non-negative}}\ &= - \log p_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{0}) + \mathbb{E}_{\mathbf{x}_{1:T}\sim q(\mathbf{x}_{1:T} \vert \mathbf{x}_{0})} \Big[ \log rac{q(\mathbf{x}_{1:T}\vert\mathbf{x}_{0})}{p_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{0:T}) / p_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{0})} \Big] \ &= - \log p_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{0}) + \mathbb{E}_q \Big[ \log rac{q(\mathbf{x}_{1:T}\vert\mathbf{x}_{0})}{p_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{0:T})} + \log p_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{0}) \Big] \ &= \mathbb{E}_q \Big[ \log rac{q(\mathbf{x}_{1:T}\vert\mathbf{x}_{0})}{p_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{0:T})} \Big] \ ext{Let }L_ ext{VLB} &= \mathbb{E}_{q(\mathbf{x}_{0:T})} \Big[ \log rac{q(\mathbf{x}_{1:T}\vert\mathbf{x}_{0})}{p_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{0:T})} \Big] \geq - \mathbb{E}_{q(\mathbf{x}_{0})} \log p_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{0}) \end{aligned}\] \[ egin{aligned} L_ ext{VLB} &= (略过推导) \ &= \mathbb{E}_q [\underbrace{D_ ext{KL}(q(\mathbf{x}_{T} \vert \mathbf{x}_{0}) \parallel p_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{T}))}_{L_{T}} + \sum_{t=2}^T \underbrace{D_ ext{KL}(q(\mathbf{x}_{t-1} \vert \mathbf{x}_{t}, \mathbf{x}_{0}) \parallel p_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{t-1} \vert\mathbf{x}_{t}))}_{L_{t-1}} \underbrace{- \log p_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{0} \vert \mathbf{x}_{1})}_{L_{0}} ] \end{aligned}\]

T和0都是常数，所以主要优化目标为$L_{t-1}$（对于t+1步则为$L_{t}$）

生成器在扩散模型中的形式是去噪，以$x_{t}$为输入，预测$x_{t-1}$，相当于 $p_ heta(x_{t-1} \vert x_{t}) = \mathcal{N}(x_{t-1}; \mu_ heta(x_{t}, t), \Sigma_ heta(x_{t}, t))$，其中$ heta$是网络参数，根据前面的推导：

\[ egin{aligned} oldsymbol{\mu}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{t}, t) &= { rac{1}{\sqrt{\alpha_{t}}} \Big( \mathbf{x}_{t} - rac{1 - \alpha_{t}}{\sqrt{1 - ar{\alpha}_{t}}} oldsymbol{\epsilon}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{t}, t) \Big)} \ ext{Thus }\mathbf{x}_{t-1} &= \mathcal{N}(\mathbf{x}_{t-1}; rac{1}{\sqrt{\alpha_{t}}} \Big( \mathbf{x}_{t} - rac{1 - \alpha_{t}}{\sqrt{1 - ar{\alpha}_{t}}} oldsymbol{\epsilon}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{t}, t) \Big), oldsymbol{\Sigma}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{t}, t)) \end{aligned}\]

最终目标则为：

\[ egin{aligned} L_{t} &= \mathbb{E}_{\mathbf{x}_{0}, oldsymbol{\epsilon}} \Big[ rac{1}{2 \| oldsymbol{\Sigma}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{t}, t) \|^2_2} \| { ilde{ oldsymbol{\mu}}_{t}(\mathbf{x}_{t}, \mathbf{x}_{0})} - { oldsymbol{\mu}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{t}, t)} \|^2 \Big] \ &= \mathbb{E}_{\mathbf{x}_{0}, oldsymbol{\epsilon}} \Big[ rac{1}{2 \| oldsymbol{\Sigma}_ heta \|^2_2} \| { rac{1}{\sqrt{\alpha_{t}}} \Big( \mathbf{x}_{t} - rac{1 - \alpha_{t}}{\sqrt{1 - ar{\alpha}_{t}}} oldsymbol{\epsilon}_{t} \Big)} - { rac{1}{\sqrt{\alpha_{t}}} \Big( \mathbf{x}_{t} - rac{1 - \alpha_{t}}{\sqrt{1 - ar{\alpha}_{t}}} oldsymbol{ oldsymbol{\epsilon}}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{t}, t) \Big)} \|^2 \Big] \ &= \mathbb{E}_{\mathbf{x}_{0}, oldsymbol{\epsilon}} \Big[ rac{ (1 - \alpha_{t})^2 }{2 \alpha_{t} (1 - ar{\alpha}_{t}) \| oldsymbol{\Sigma}_ heta \|^2_2} \| oldsymbol{\epsilon}_{t} - oldsymbol{\epsilon}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{t}, t)\|^2 \Big] \ &= \mathbb{E}_{\mathbf{x}_{0}, oldsymbol{\epsilon}} \Big[ rac{ (1 - \alpha_{t})^2 }{2 \alpha_{t} (1 - ar{\alpha}_{t}) \| oldsymbol{\Sigma}_ heta \|^2_2} \| oldsymbol{\epsilon}_{t} - oldsymbol{\epsilon}_ heta(\sqrt{ ar{\alpha}_{t}}\mathbf{x}_{0} + \sqrt{1 - ar{\alpha}_{t}} oldsymbol{\epsilon}_{t}, t)\|^2 \Big] \end{aligned}\]

简化后为：

\[ egin{aligned} L_{t}^ ext{simple} &= \mathbb{E}_{t \sim [1, T], \mathbf{x}_{0}, oldsymbol{\epsilon}_{t}} \Big[\| oldsymbol{\epsilon}_{t} - oldsymbol{\epsilon}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_{t}, t)\|^2 \Big] \ &= \mathbb{E}_{t \sim [1, T], \mathbf{x}_{0}, oldsymbol{\epsilon}_{t}} \Big[\| oldsymbol{\epsilon}_{t} - oldsymbol{\epsilon}_ heta(\sqrt{ ar{\alpha}_{t}}\mathbf{x}_{0} + \sqrt{1 - ar{\alpha}_{t}} oldsymbol{\epsilon}_{t}, t)\|^2 \Big] \end{aligned}\]

与DDPM论文一致。

DDIM

DDIM本质上在DDPM的基础上在反向生成过程中去掉了随机性，首先引入参数 $\sigma_t$ 对生成过程重参数化：

\[ egin{aligned} \mathbf{x}_{t-1} &= \sqrt{ ar{\alpha}_{t-1}}\mathbf{x}_0 + \sqrt{1 - ar{\alpha}_{t-1}} oldsymbol{\epsilon}_{t-1} & \ &= \sqrt{ ar{\alpha}_{t-1}}\mathbf{x}_0 + \sqrt{1 - ar{\alpha}_{t-1} - \sigma_t^2} oldsymbol{\epsilon}_t + \sigma_t oldsymbol{\epsilon} & \ &= \sqrt{ ar{\alpha}_{t-1}} \Big( rac{\mathbf{x}_t - \sqrt{1 - ar{\alpha}_t} \epsilon^{(t)}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_t)}{\sqrt{ ar{\alpha}_t}} \Big) + \sqrt{1 - ar{\alpha}_{t-1} - \sigma_t^2} \epsilon^{(t)}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_t) + \sigma_t oldsymbol{\epsilon} \ q_\sigma(\mathbf{x}_{t-1} \vert \mathbf{x}_t, \mathbf{x}_0) &= \mathcal{N}(\mathbf{x}_{t-1}; \sqrt{ ar{\alpha}_{t-1}} \Big( rac{\mathbf{x}_t - \sqrt{1 - ar{\alpha}_t} \epsilon^{(t)}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_t)}{\sqrt{ ar{\alpha}_t}} \Big) + \sqrt{1 - ar{\alpha}_{t-1} - \sigma_t^2} \epsilon^{(t)}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_t), \sigma_t^2 \mathbf{I}) \end{aligned}\]

可以发现网络参数固定后，仍然有随机性在，这就导致无法跨多步，因此只要去掉这个随机性，将$\sigma_t$置零，就可以在采样的时候跨多步预测噪声（deterministic generation），这个性质也非常好地帮助对预训练diffusion进行蒸馏。

条件生成

Classifier Guided Genration

基于预训练的生成模型，在生成每一步用一个分类器的梯度去引导往某个特定条件去生成，结合score-function进行推导，无条件DDPM的score-function为： \( abla_{\mathbf{x}_t} \log q(\mathbf{x}_t) = - rac{ oldsymbol{\epsilon}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_t, t)}{\sqrt{1 - ar{\alpha}_t}}\) 这个梯度在score-matching的时候跟diffusion做backward生成去掉的噪声是一直的，在此基础上加入条件$y$以及分类器$f_\phi(.)$: \( egin{aligned} abla_{\mathbf{x}_t} \log q(\mathbf{x}_t, y) &= abla_{\mathbf{x}_t} \log q(\mathbf{x}_t) + abla_{\mathbf{x}_t} \log q(y \vert \mathbf{x}_t) \ &\approx - rac{1}{\sqrt{1 - ar{\alpha}_t}} oldsymbol{\epsilon}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_t, t) + abla_{\mathbf{x}_t} \log f_\phi(y \vert \mathbf{x}_t) \ &= - rac{1}{\sqrt{1 - ar{\alpha}_t}} ( oldsymbol{\epsilon}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_t, t) - \sqrt{1 - ar{\alpha}_t} abla_{\mathbf{x}_t} \log f_\phi(y \vert \mathbf{x}_t)) \end{aligned}\) 新的梯度信息（噪声）$ abla_{x_{t}}\log q(\mathbf{x}t, y)$代替原本的$ abla{x_{t}}\log q(\mathbf{x}_t)$参与生成，随着timestep慢慢引导生成目标图像。

Classifier-Free Guidance

不基于分类器的生成需要从头训练，基于原本的优化目标建立基于条件$y$的联合分布，即$q(x_{t-1} \vert x_{t})$ 变成$q(x_{t-1} \vert x_{t},y)$，相当于除了时间条件t加了一个其他条件$y$，由于新增了一个条件，可以通过计算condition与uncondtion的结果做差，使得生成更往条件的方向去靠，仍旧基于score-function推导： \( egin{aligned} abla_{\mathbf{x}_t} \log p(y \vert \mathbf{x}_t) &= abla_{\mathbf{x}_t} \log p(\mathbf{x}_t \vert y) - abla_{\mathbf{x}_t} \log p(\mathbf{x}_t) \ &= - rac{1}{\sqrt{1 - ar{\alpha}_t}}\Big( oldsymbol{\epsilon}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_t, t, y) - oldsymbol{\epsilon}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_t, t) \Big) \ ar{ oldsymbol{\epsilon}}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_t, t, y) &= oldsymbol{\epsilon}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_t, t, y) - \sqrt{1 - ar{\alpha}_t} \; w abla_{\mathbf{x}_t} \log p(y \vert \mathbf{x}_t) \ &= oldsymbol{\epsilon}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_t, t, y) + w ig( oldsymbol{\epsilon}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_t, t, y) - oldsymbol{\epsilon}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_t, t) ig) \ &= (w+1) oldsymbol{\epsilon}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_t, t, y) - w oldsymbol{\epsilon}_ heta(\mathbf{x}_t, t) \end{aligned}\)
